blocks.text: **too** «kerakligidan ko'p, me'yordan ortiq» degani — va bu doim **muammo**: kiyib bo'lmaydi, ichib bo'lmaydi, sotib olib bo'lmaydi. O'zbekchada buni «juda», «haddan tashqari», «o'ta» bilan yoki chiroyli `-lik qiladi` qolipi bilan aytamiz: This jacket is **too big** — Bu kurtka menga **kattalik qiladi**. **enough** dan farqli (91-dars), **too** doim sifat yoki ravishdan **oldin** turadi: **too** big, **too** fast.

O'zbekcha «juda» inglizchada ikki xil bo'lishi mumkin. **very** — shunchaki «juda», muammo yo'q: The tea is **very** hot (issiq, lekin icha olaman). **too** — «haddan tashqari», natijada nimadir qilib bo'lmaydi: The tea is **too** hot (ichib bo'lmaydi). Shuning uchun maqtov uchun **too** ishlatilmaydi: «The film was too good» — g'alati eshitiladi, to'g'risi: **very** good, **really** good.

rows: The tea is **very** hot, but I can drink it.
The tea is **too** hot. I can't drink it.
The bag is **very** expensive, but I'll buy it.
The bag is **too** expensive. I can't buy it.
The street is **very** busy, but we can cross.
The street is **too** busy. We can't cross here.

items.text: This jacket is **too small** — I need a bigger size.
items.translation: Bu kurtka **torlik qiladi** — menga kattaroq o'lcham kerak.

items.text: The museum was **very** crowded, but we saw everything.
items.translation: Muzey **juda** gavjum edi, lekin hamma narsani ko'rdik.

blocks.text: Ot bilan **too much** yoki **too many** ishlatiladi (83-darsdagi much / many qoidasi): **too much** + sanalmaydigan ot (too much salt, too much noise, too much time), **too many** + sanaladigan ko'plik ot (too many cars, too many questions). Otsiz, fe'ldan keyin — **too much**: You work **too much** (Haddan tashqari ko'p ishlaysiz). I ate **too much** (Ortiqcha yeb qo'ydim).

items.text: There's **too much** traffic in the morning.
Dilnoza works **too much** and never takes a holiday.
items.translation: Dilnoza **haddan tashqari ko'p** ishlaydi va hech qachon ta'tilga chiqmaydi.

blocks.text: Kim yoki nima uchun ortiqcha ekanini aytish uchun **for** + ot / olmosh: too big **for me** — menga kattalik qiladi, too cold **for the children** — bolalar uchun juda sovuq. Nima qilib bo'lmasligini aytish uchun **to** + fe'l: too tired **to walk** — yurolmaydigan darajada charchagan. Ikkalasi birga: too heavy **for me to carry** — men ko'tara olmaydigan darajada og'ir. E'tibor bering: gap oxirida **it** qo'yilmaydi — «too heavy to carry it» emas, **too heavy to carry**, chunki «nima og'ir?» degan savolga gapning boshi allaqachon javob bergan.

items.text: The film is **too scary for** small children.
We were **too tired to** go out last night.
This text is **too long for me to** read in five minutes.
items.translation: Bu matn **men besh daqiqada o'qiy olmaydigan darajada** uzun.

blocks.text: Bir fikrni ikki tomondan aytish mumkin: The room is **too small** = The room **isn't big enough** (91-dars). **too** + qarama-qarshi sifat = **not** + sifat + **enough**: too slow = not fast enough, too young = not old enough, too cold = not warm enough.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «too much big» → **too big** (sifat oldida much kerak emas); «too many money» → **too much money** (money sanalmaydi); «It's very hot to drink» → It's **too** hot to drink; «too heavy to carry it» → **too heavy to carry**; «The concert was too good!» → **very / really good** (too — salbiy ma'no). **too** gap oxirida «ham» ma'nosida ham keladi: I'm hungry **too** — Men ham ochman (42-dars) — bu boshqa ma'no.
Tekshirish usuli: gapdan keyin «... shuning uchun qila olmayman» deb qo'sha olsangiz — **too**; «... lekin mayli» desangiz — **very**. Too hot → can't drink; very hot → but OK.
Bog'lanish: enough (big enough, enough money) — 91-dars; much / many — 83-dars; too / either («ham») — 42-dars.

items: **too** + sifat / ravish: **too** big, **too** fast — haddan tashqari, «-lik qiladi»;
**too much** + sanalmaydigan ot, **too many** + sanaladigan ot; fe'ldan keyin — **too much**;
kimga — **for**: too big **for me**; nima qilib bo'lmaydi — **to** + fe'l: too tired **to walk**; oxirida it yo'q;

examples.title: **too** + adjective: **too big**, **too expensive**
examples.description: **too** sifatdan **oldin** keladi va «me'yordan ortiq — muammo» degani: This jacket is **too big** — Bu kurtka **kattalik qiladi**.

sentences.text: This jacket is **too big** — have you got a smaller size?
sentences.translation: Bu kurtka **kattalik qiladi** — kichikroq o'lcham bormi?

sentences.text: The coffee is **too hot** — wait a minute.
sentences.translation: Qahva **juda issiq** — bir daqiqa kuting.

sentences.text: We didn't buy the flat because it was **too expensive**.
sentences.translation: Kvartirani sotib olmadik, chunki **haddan tashqari qimmat** edi.

sentences.text: Is the music **too loud**? I can turn it down.
sentences.translation: Musiqa **juda balandmi**? Pasaytirib qo'yishim mumkin.

sentences.text: These trousers are **too short** now — you've grown so much!
sentences.translation: Bu shim endi **kaltalik qiladi** — juda o'sib ketibsan!

sentences.text: Sorry, I can't come — I'm **too busy** this week.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, kela olmayman — bu hafta **juda bandman**.

sentences.text: Madina didn't like the hotel. The rooms were **too small** and **too dark**.
sentences.translation: Madinaga mehmonxona yoqmadi. Xonalar **juda kichik** va **juda qorong'i** edi.

sentences.text: The soup is **too salty** — did you put salt in it twice?
sentences.translation: Sho'rva **sho'r bo'lib ketibdi** — ikki marta tuz soldingmi?

sentences.text: Tourists don't visit Bukhara much in August — it's **too hot**.
sentences.translation: Avgustda sayyohlar Buxoroga kam borishadi — havo **o'ta issiq**.

sentences.text: The exam questions were **too difficult**, and nobody finished on time.
sentences.translation: Imtihon savollari **haddan tashqari qiyin** edi, hech kim vaqtida tugata olmadi.

examples.title: **too** + adverb: **too fast**, **too late**
examples.description: **too** ravishdan ham oldin keladi: **too fast**, **too quickly**, **too late**, **too early** — «juda, haddan tashqari».

sentences.text: You're driving **too fast** — slow down!
sentences.translation: **Juda tez** haydayapsiz — sekinlating!

sentences.text: We arrived **too late**, and the museum was already closed.
sentences.translation: **Juda kech** yetib keldik, muzey allaqachon yopilgan edi.

sentences.text: Our teacher speaks **too quickly**, and I can't follow her.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchimiz **juda tez** gapiradi, men tushunib ulgurmayman.

sentences.text: Don't get up **too early** tomorrow — it's Sunday.
sentences.translation: Ertaga **juda erta** turmang — yakshanba.

sentences.text: The waiter brought our food **too slowly**, so we left without dessert.
sentences.translation: Ofitsiant ovqatimizni **juda sekin** olib keldi, shuning uchun shirinliksiz ketdik.

sentences.text: Is Aziz working **too hard**? He looks exhausted.
sentences.translation: Aziz **haddan tashqari ko'p** ishlayaptimi? Juda holdan toygan ko'rinadi.

sentences.text: Tom always leaves things **too late** and then panics.
sentences.translation: Tom doim ishlarni **oxirgi daqiqaga** qoldiradi, keyin vahimaga tushadi.

sentences.text: My phone battery dies **too quickly** these days.
sentences.translation: Bu kunlarda telefonimning batareyasi **juda tez** tugayapti.

sentences.text: Sarah sings beautifully, but she sang **too quietly** at the concert.
sentences.translation: Sara chiroyli kuylaydi, lekin konsertda **juda past** ovozda kuyladi.

sentences.text: Grandad says young people today live **too fast** and never rest.
sentences.translation: Bobomning aytishicha, hozirgi yoshlar **juda shoshib** yashaydi va hech dam olmaydi.

examples.title: **too much** / **too many**
examples.description: **too much** + sanalmaydigan ot (too much sugar), **too many** + sanaladigan ko'plik ot (too many cars). Fe'ldan keyin yolg'iz: You talk **too much**.

sentences.text: There's **too much** sugar in this tea.
sentences.translation: Bu choyda shakar **juda ko'p**.

sentences.text: There are **too many** cars in the city centre.
sentences.translation: Shahar markazida mashinalar **haddan tashqari ko'p**.

sentences.text: You spend **too much** time on your phone.
sentences.translation: Telefoningga **juda ko'p** vaqt sarflaysan.

sentences.text: I ate **too much** at the wedding, and now I feel sick.
sentences.translation: To'yda **ortiqcha** yeb qo'ydim, endi ko'nglim aynayapti.

sentences.text: Bekzod has got **too many** things to do this week.
sentences.translation: Bekzodning bu hafta qiladigan ishlari **juda ko'p**.

sentences.text: Don't put **too much** salt in the salad.
sentences.translation: Salatga tuzni **ko'p** solib yubormang.

sentences.text: Were there **too many** people at the concert? — Yes, it was really crowded.
sentences.translation: Konsertda odam **juda ko'p** edimi? — Ha, rosa gavjum edi.

sentences.text: James talks **too much** in meetings, and nobody else can speak.
sentences.translation: Jeyms yig'ilishlarda **juda ko'p** gapiradi, boshqalar gapira olmaydi.

sentences.text: We took **too many** photos, and now there's no space on my phone.
sentences.translation: **Juda ko'p** surat olibmiz, endi telefonimda joy qolmadi.

sentences.text: Our neighbours make **too much** noise late at night.
sentences.translation: Qo'shnilarimiz kechasi **juda ko'p** shovqin qilishadi.

examples.title: **very** or **too**?
examples.description: **very** — «juda» (fakt, muammo yo'q), **too** — «haddan tashqari» (muammo: qilib bo'lmaydi). Juft gaplar: It's **very** hot, but I like it ↔ It's **too** hot — I can't drink it.

sentences.text: The tea is **very** hot, but I like it that way.
sentences.translation: Choy **juda** issiq, lekin men shunday yaxshi ko'raman.

sentences.text: The tea is **too** hot — I can't drink it yet.
sentences.translation: Choy **haddan tashqari** issiq — hali icholmayman.

sentences.text: This bag is **very** expensive, but it's beautiful, so I'll buy it.
sentences.translation: Bu sumka **juda** qimmat, lekin chiroyli, shuning uchun olaman.

sentences.text: That car is **too** expensive — we can't afford it.
sentences.translation: U mashina **o'ta** qimmat — qurbimiz yetmaydi.

sentences.text: Madina is **very** young, but she's an excellent doctor.
sentences.translation: Madina **juda** yosh, lekin a'lo shifokor.

sentences.text: Madina's son is **too** young for school — he's only five.
sentences.translation: Madinaning o'g'li maktab uchun **hali juda** yosh — endi besh yoshda.

sentences.text: It was **very** cold in Samarkand, so we wore warm coats.
sentences.translation: Samarqandda **juda** sovuq edi, shuning uchun issiq palto kiydik.

sentences.text: It was **too** cold to go out, so we stayed in the hotel.
sentences.translation: Tashqariga chiqib bo'lmaydigan darajada **haddan tashqari** sovuq edi, shuning uchun mehmonxonada qoldik.

sentences.text: The film was **very** long, but it was never boring.
sentences.translation: Film **juda** uzun edi, lekin umuman zerikarli emasdi.

sentences.text: This walk is **too** long for Grandma — let's take a taxi.
sentences.translation: Bu yo'l buvim uchun **o'ta uzoq** — taksiga o'tiraylik.

examples.title: **too** ... **for** ...: **too small for me**
examples.description: **too** + sifat + **for** + kishi / narsa — «... uchun haddan tashqari», o'zbekchada ko'pincha «-lik qiladi»: too small **for me** — menga **torlik qiladi**.

sentences.text: These shoes are **too small for** me.
sentences.translation: Bu tuflilar menga **torlik qiladi**.

sentences.text: The flat is **too big for** just one person.
sentences.translation: Kvartira bir kishi **uchun juda katta**.

sentences.text: Is the water **too cold for** the children?
sentences.translation: Suv bolalar **uchun juda sovuqmi**?

sentences.text: This book is **too difficult for** beginners.
sentences.translation: Bu kitob boshlovchilar **uchun juda qiyin**.

sentences.text: The suitcase was **too heavy for** Grandma, so I carried it.
sentences.translation: Chamadon buvim **uchun juda og'ir** edi, shuning uchun men ko'tardim.

sentences.text: Our old car is **too slow for** long journeys.
sentences.translation: Eski mashinamiz uzoq safarlar **uchun juda sekin**.

sentences.text: That dress looks **too long for** you — try the shorter one.
sentences.translation: U ko'ylak sizga **uzunlik qilyapti** — kaltarog'ini kiyib ko'ring.

sentences.text: The questions were **too easy for** Dilnoza — she finished in ten minutes.
sentences.translation: Savollar Dilnoza **uchun juda oson** edi — u o'n daqiqada tugatdi.

sentences.text: Sorry, it's **too late for** coffee — I won't sleep.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, qahva **ichish uchun juda kech** — uxlay olmay qolaman.

sentences.text: We can't use the kitchen table — it's **too small for** eight people.
sentences.translation: Oshxonadagi stol yaramaydi — sakkiz kishiga **torlik qiladi**.

examples.title: **too** ... **to** ...: **too tired to cook**
examples.description: **too** + sifat + **to** + fe'l — «... qila olmaydigan darajada»: **too tired to cook** — ovqat pishirishga holim yo'q. Kim uchun: too heavy **for me to carry** (oxirida «it» qo'yilmaydi).

sentences.text: I'm **too tired to** cook tonight — let's order pizza.
sentences.translation: Bugun ovqat **pishirishga holim yo'q** — pitsa buyurtma qilaylik.

sentences.text: It's **too cold to** swim in the sea in April.
sentences.translation: Aprelda dengizda cho'milish uchun **haddan tashqari sovuq**.

sentences.text: Bekzod was **too nervous to** say anything at the interview.
sentences.translation: Suhbatda Bekzod **hayajondan hech narsa deya olmadi**.

sentences.text: This box is **too heavy for me to** carry.
sentences.translation: Bu quti **men ko'tara olmaydigan darajada** og'ir.

sentences.text: Grandad is **too old to** travel alone now.
sentences.translation: Bobom endi yolg'iz sayohat qilish uchun **juda keksa**.

sentences.text: Emma spoke **too quickly for us to** understand.
sentences.translation: Emma **biz tushuna olmaydigan darajada** tez gapirdi.

sentences.text: Is it **too late to** buy tickets for tonight? — No, there are still some left.
sentences.translation: Bugungi kechaga chipta **olishga kech emasmi**? — Yo'q, hali bor.

sentences.text: The instructions were **too complicated for** Aziz **to** follow.
sentences.translation: Ko'rsatmalar **Aziz tushunolmaydigan darajada** murakkab edi.

sentences.text: The children were **too excited to** sleep before the trip.
sentences.translation: Safar oldidan bolalar **hayajondan uxlay olishmadi**.

sentences.text: The sun was **too bright to** look at, so we put on our sunglasses.
sentences.translation: Quyosh **qarab bo'lmaydigan darajada** charaqlardi, shuning uchun quyosh ko'zoynaklarimizni taqdik.

examples.title: **too short** = **not long enough**
examples.description: Bir fikr ikki xil: **too small** = **not big enough** (91-dars). Tasdiq va inkor yonma-yon: It's **too** short — it **isn't** long **enough**.

sentences.text: The bed is **too short** — it **isn't long enough** for me.
sentences.translation: Karavot **juda kalta** — menga **yetarlicha uzun emas**.

sentences.text: This coat is **too thin** — it **isn't warm enough** for January.
sentences.translation: Bu palto **juda yupqa** — yanvar uchun **yetarlicha issiq emas**.

sentences.text: Aziz is **too young** to vote — he **isn't old enough**.
sentences.translation: Aziz ovoz berish uchun **juda yosh** — **yoshi yetmagan**.

sentences.text: The bus is **too slow** — it **isn't fast enough** for people in a hurry.
sentences.translation: Avtobus **juda sekin** — shoshayotganlar uchun **yetarlicha tez emas**.

sentences.text: Is the room **too dark**? — Yes, there **isn't enough** light.
sentences.translation: Xona **juda qorong'imi**? — Ha, yorug'lik **yetishmaydi**.

sentences.text: My salary is **too low** — I **don't earn enough** to rent a flat in London.
sentences.translation: Maoshim **juda kam** — Londonda kvartira ijaraga olishga **pulim yetmaydi**.

sentences.text: The shelf is **too high** — I'm **not tall enough** to reach it.
sentences.translation: Javon **juda baland** — **bo'yim yetmaydi**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza's coffee is **too weak** — she **didn't put enough** coffee in it.
sentences.translation: Dilnozaning qahvasi **juda suyuq** — u **yetarlicha** qahva solmagan.

sentences.text: There are **too many** students in the class and **not enough** chairs.
sentences.translation: Sinfda talabalar **juda ko'p**, stullar esa **yetmaydi**.

sentences.text: We left **too late**, so we didn't get there **early enough** to find a good seat.
sentences.translation: **Juda kech** yo'lga chiqdik, shuning uchun yaxshi joy topishga **ulgurmadik**.

examples.title: Dialogue: the jeans are **too tight**
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: do'konda jinsi tanlash — **too** + sifat, **too much**, **very** va **not too** ...

sentences.text: — Well? How are the jeans? Are they **too tight**?
sentences.translation: — Xo'sh? Jinsi qanday? **Torlik qilmayaptimi**?

sentences.text: — A bit. And they're **too long** — look at the bottom!
sentences.translation: — Sal-pal. Ustiga **uzunlik qilyapti** — pastiga qarang!

sentences.text: — Try this pair. They're a bit **bigger**, but **not too big**.
sentences.translation: — Mana bunisini kiyib ko'ring. Sal **kattaroq**, lekin **juda katta emas**.

sentences.text: — These are better, but the colour is **too dark** for summer.
sentences.translation: — Bular yaxshiroq, lekin rangi yoz uchun **juda to'q**.

sentences.text: — What about light blue? That colour is **very popular** this year.
sentences.translation: — Och ko'k-chi? Bu rang bu yil **juda mashhur**.

sentences.text: — Hmm, they're nice, but eighty pounds is **too much** for jeans.
sentences.translation: — Hmm, chiroyli, lekin jinsi uchun sakson funt **juda qimmat**.

sentences.text: — I understand. These ones are cheaper, but they're **too short** for you.
sentences.translation: — Tushunaman. Bunisi arzonroq, lekin sizga **kaltalik qiladi**.

sentences.text: — You're right, I'm **too tall** for most cheap jeans!
sentences.translation: — To'g'ri aytasiz, arzon jinsilarning ko'piga bo'yim **balandlik qiladi**!

sentences.text: — Then the light blue ones are best. They're **not too tight** and **not too long**.
sentences.translation: — Unda och ko'k rangdagisi eng ma'quli. **Tor ham emas**, **uzun ham emas**.

sentences.text: — OK, I'll take them. I've spent **too much** time in shops today anyway!
sentences.translation: — Mayli, olaman. Baribir bugun do'konlarda **juda ko'p** vaqt o'tkazdim!
